g.data-route: agreement at first reading: the Council approved the EP position

text.tspan: Legislative procedure – Internal market emergency directive – Directive (EU) 2024/2749

Procedure 2022/0280(COD). Route: agreement at first reading: the Council approved the EP position. Upper part: the ordinary legislative procedure (Art. 294 TFEU); lower part: the act's procedure over time. Every event cites its source (see internal-market-emergency-directive.html).
Act adopted in the wording of the EP
approves or no decision → adopted (7a); rejects
both adopt → adopted; otherwise not adopted
Informal: trilogues of EP, Council and Commission at every stage (Joint Declaration 2007, points 7–9); a trilogue agreement confirmed by Coreper and
offered by letter to the EP committee chair (point 14) leads to adoption at first reading, or, after the EP first reading, to an early second reading.
